figures.takeaway: Median absolute disagreement is 6.7 bp, or 2.16% of the VaR level. Against M1, M2 shifts VaR by +0.039 standardised units on neutral text, -0.065 on very adverse text and -0.089 on very positive text — so it is the confidence of the text that deepens the tail, not its direction, and the residual asymmetry runs slightly the other way.
figures.title: Sentiment moves the tail through intensity, not direction — and only by a couple of percent

figures.takeaway: 470 of 1,788,865 firm-days (0.026%) are flagged, and they breach at 66% against 3.0% on clean days. Common targets enter each model's nonlinear FZ0 loss differently, so they can move M2-vs-M1; the declared repair check moved the estimate but its interval still spanned zero.
